messages:
Priya: Quick sync — Phoenix Catalyst POC completed first week. Customer wants to swap from shipped model `redwood/llama30b-v1` to a custom variant `phoenix/llama30b-q4k` for improved throughput. Need: rough pricing delta, KV-cache behavior, and any security/KMS blockers if they request key-managed encryption for prompts. Can dev/infra weigh in?
Diego: Re pricing — q4k quant usually ~35-45% cheaper per token on our dedicated pools, depends on perf curve. For Hosted API we'd show an estimate; for Dedicated we need a re-quote since reserved capacity may change.
Matt: Short answers: 1) Compatibility: variant looks architecturally compatible (same vocab/arch) but we must run a fast weight-check and perf probe to confirm kernel path. 2) KV cache: quantized weights change cache hit behavior? Not really — prefix/KV caching stays the same; caveat is KV size in RAM may differ, check memory footprint. 3) Security: KMS gating OK, but if they want customer-managed keys + Private deployment we need Private mode + KMS integration.
Priya: Helpful. Can you outline the preflight checks we should run so sales can ask customer for data? Also need to know if canary rollouts are supported for mid-POC swaps.
Matt: Preflight checklist (quick):
- confirm tokenizer/vocab hash matches
- run weight hash diff: `rdw weight-check --from redwood/llama30b-v1 --to phoenix/llama30b-q4k`
- perf probe: `rdw probe --model phoenix/llama30b-q4k --seq 2048 --batch 4` (collect p50/p95/p99 latency)
- mem estimate: `rdw mem-est --model phoenix/llama30b-q4k`
- run small eval set for quality regressions (we can provide eval harness)
Canary: yes — we support route-based rollout. You can pin a % of traffic to variant and fallback to baseline automatically on errors/latency spikes.
Diego: For pricing ask: tell them delta is estimate until we run perf probe. If they need firm numbers for contract, we need a Dedicated sizing + usage profile. I'll draft the email template.
Priya: About KMS — customer insists on BYOK + HSM-backed keys and audit logs. Is that doable in a hosted trial?
Matt: BYOK + HSM requires Private deployment or Dedicated with the KMS bridge. Hosted can do encrypted-at-rest but not customer HSM for trial. For enterprise POC we recommend spinning up a Private trial (VPC) — we have a quickstart doc and a compliance checklist.
Priya: Can you open an infra ticket to run the compatibility probe and perf probe? ETA ideally by EOD tomorrow so I can get numbers to the AE.
Matt: Opening ticket now.
deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-7281: "phoenix/llama30b-q4k compatibility + perf probe" assigned to @Matt.
Matt: I'll run the weight-check and probe this afternoon, will paste results here.
Diego: I'll prep the pricing note and a short contract clause about variant swaps and re-quoting.
Priya: Thanks — feel free to @me with updates. :thumbsup:
